title: Fixed Forked Stock and Slotted Bevel Rule
description: One newly authored complete fixed sliding-bevel-style exterior. One long thick stock contains two continuous cheeks joined by a full rear bridge, leaving a genuine long side-open blade recess. A separate entire blunt long blade has a true closed longitudinal through-slot and is held in a fixed oblique open pose on one complete transverse pivot. A thick washer and whole two-wing retaining cap join the pivot above the stock. The fixed shaft intentionally occupies a short part of the blade slot, not an empty assembled bore. This end-pivoted slotted blade inside a forked hand stock is newly authored, not the old 90/45 combination-square stock with its straight transverse sliding rule turned, and not the old two-ended sighting rule above a circular astrolabe. All geometry original, three opaque solid PBR roles, one model zero scenes. No calibrated ticks, blade sharpness, angle reading, sliding or rotation travel, locking force, hand fit, operation or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
